sam (AE): Quick: Prospect Orion wants a 3-week POC. Must be EU-only, prefer customer-managed keys, target p95 <=250ms for ~512-token answers. Load: 40 RPS steady, 150 RPS bursts. Need concrete pass/fail for quality + perf and a short runbook they can run. cc @mira @kai @jules

mira (Solutions): Noted. They mentioned a Llama-ish 33B quality but ok with 13B quant if cost helps. Use cases: RAG Q&A + short generation. My recommendation: stage 1 Hosted (eu-west) for quick evals, stage 2 Dedicated (eu-west) sized for steady state. Private/VPC only if they insist on VPC+CMK day 1.

kai (SRE): For p95 250ms at 512 tokens and 40RPS steady, Dedicated gives predictable tail latency. Hosted can work but expect higher variance unless we oversize. For 150RPS bursts, add burst capacity or overflow to a lower-cost Hosted fallback. We'll document routing policy.

jules (Security): CMK in eu-west-1 supported. Confirm SOC2 requirement? Also need retention window for logs and whether Splunk/Datadog integration required. I can prefill questionnaire if we get the vendor contact.

sam (AE): SOC2 required, they want CMK ownership, 365d EU-only audit logs, and Splunk forwarder. No HIPAA.

mira (Solutions): Proposed POC acceptance criteria: 1) Quality: 150 labeled prompts across top intents, automated eval harness with >=90% semantic pass rate (embedding similarity + spot-check exactness). 2) Perf: p95 <=250ms for 512-token responses at 40RPS steady; during 150RPS burst p95 <=600ms. 3) Security: CMK confirmed + SOC2 doc + EU-only logs. 4) Cost: show day-rate for Dedicated (13B quant) vs Hosted per-token for 1M tokens/day.

kai (SRE): Quick runbook snippets for customer-run tests:
- curl sample for Hosted (eu-west):
  curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"model":"rw-13b-quant","prompt":"<test>","max_tokens":512}'
- k6 burst: k6 run --vus 150 --duration 3m burst_test.js
- wrk steady: wrk -t4 -c40 -d5m https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
I'll drop these into the runbook.

ci-bot: Runbook created: https://internal.redwood/sops/pocs/orion-poc. Contains deploy checklist, eval harness, routing policy template.

jules (Security): I'll draft questionnaire answers and attach SOC2 PDF. Need Orion infosec contact to share CMK steps.

mira (Solutions): Timeline suggestion: Week 0 kickoff + Hosted provision; Week 1 functional evals & prompt tuning; Week 2 Dedicated bring-up & load tests; Week 3 acceptance & report. If Orion insists on Private/VPC+CMK day 0, add one week.

sam (AE): Action list: mira: cost deltas (13B vs 33B) + token examples; kai: add runbook snippets + routing policy; jules: finish questionnaire + SOC2; sam: schedule kickoff with Orion and include infosec. I'll propose the staged path on the call. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
